title: osf verify becomes a moon-driven checkpoint runner
summary: `osf verify` stops running checks in-process and becomes a checkpoint runner: it selects the moon tasks tagged for a checkpoint (hook, pre-commit, pre-push, pull-request, schedule), hands moon the affected file list over stdin, and reads moon's run report plus each task's SARIF output back. Each check is now its own `osf check <name>` command, so moon can cache and parallelise them; every run appends hash-chained verification events to a local journal buffer. Alongside it, git calls are made hermetic against an inherited GIT_DIR/GIT_INDEX_FILE, hooks move out of the repository into `osf hooks install`, and a new `hook post-tool` event runs the hook checkpoint on the file an agent just wrote.

lanes.label: Entry points
lanes.subtitle: what invokes a checkpoint
lanes.summary: The git hooks, the agent harness hook, and CI all funnel into the same `osf verify --checkpoint` entry point.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf
lanes.summary: The Rust binary: adoption detection, file selection, the moon adapter, the journal, and the individual checks.

lanes.label: moon
lanes.subtitle: task runner
lanes.summary: Runs the tagged tasks, caches them, and writes a run report plus per-task stdout/stderr logs.

lanes.label: Local state
lanes.subtitle: files on disk
lanes.summary: The journal buffer, the SARIF each check writes, and moon's own cache directory.

nodes.label: git hooks
nodes.subtitle: pre-commit, pre-push, commit-msg
nodes.summary: Installed by `osf hooks install` into a folder outside the repository, with `core.hooksPath` pointed at it. Each script execs `osf verify --checkpoint <name>`; pre-push forwards git's remote name.

nodes.label: agent harness hook
nodes.subtitle: osf hook post-tool
nodes.summary: A PostToolUse event names the file an agent just wrote; the hook resolves the repository from that file's own parent and runs the hook checkpoint on it, refusing the write on an error finding.

nodes.label: CI checkpoint job
nodes.subtitle: pull_request only
nodes.summary: A new GitHub Actions job installs moon, builds osf, and runs `osf verify --checkpoint pull-request --base origin/<base_ref>`, uploading the journal buffer and SARIF output as evidence.

nodes.label: osf verify
nodes.subtitle: --checkpoint <name>
nodes.summary: Detects adoption, resolves the checkpoint, reads the hook file list from stdin when asked, and delegates to the checkpoint runner. `--stage` remains as a deprecated alias.

nodes.label: checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: checkpoint.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves the base and file list per checkpoint, writes the OSF_FILES_FROM list and its hash, takes the report lock, clears stale SARIF, runs moon, and journals one verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event.

nodes.label: osf check <name>
nodes.subtitle: scan, scan-staged, lint-writing, lint-skill, scan-commits
nodes.summary: One check, run on its own over an explicit file list (or the OSF_FILES_FROM list), writing SARIF to --sarif-out. Content source depends on the checkpoint: disk at hook, git HEAD everywhere else, the index for scan-staged.

nodes.label: moon adapter
nodes.subtitle: moon.rs
nodes.summary: Spawns `moon run :#<tag> --affected --stdin`, feeds the file list on stdin, enforces a minimum version and a timeout, and parses the run report into per-task outcomes.

nodes.label: journal
nodes.subtitle: journal.rs
nodes.summary: Appends hash-chained events to a per-run buffer file. The replay hash excludes wall-clock time, run id, duration and cache state, so two identical runs produce the same head hash.

nodes.label: git plumbing
nodes.subtitle: scrub_git_env_for_dir
nodes.summary: Every git call now removes inherited repository-locating GIT_* variables, keeps GIT_INDEX_FILE only when it lies inside the target's own git directory, and forces LC_ALL=C. Adds upstream_ref, commits_since, staged_blob_hash and local config read/write.

nodes.label: moon
nodes.subtitle: pinned 2.5.5
nodes.summary: Installed by checksum in the devcontainer and by a composite CI action. Runs the tagged tasks, caches them by input hash, and writes .moon/cache/runReport.json plus per-task stdout/stderr logs.

nodes.label: osf moon tasks
nodes.subtitle: .osf/moon.yml
nodes.summary: One task per check per checkpoint, tagged osf-hook / osf-pre-commit / osf-pre-push / osf-pull-request and osf-slot-*. Wide-glob tasks exclude git-ignored directories so moon's cache fingerprint stays stable.

nodes.label: journal buffer
nodes.subtitle: <state>/buffer/<run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: One JSONL file per run, each line a hash-chained event. A run id that already has events is refused rather than resumed.

nodes.label: SARIF output
nodes.subtitle: .osf/out/<task>.sarif
nodes.summary: Each check writes its findings as SARIF 2.1.0. The runner deletes these before moon runs and reads them back after, so a stale file is never mistaken for this run's result.

nodes.label: moon cache
nodes.subtitle: .moon/cache/
nodes.summary: Holds the run report, per-task logs, and the lock file the runner takes so two overlapping invocations never clear or read each other's report.

edges.label: verify --checkpoint
edges.summary: The installed hook scripts exec `osf verify --checkpoint <name>`; pre-push forwards git's remote name as a trailing argument.

edges.label: hook checkpoint on one file
edges.summary: The new post-tool path resolves the written file's repository and runs the hook checkpoint over exactly that file, refusing the write on an error finding.

edges.label: verify --checkpoint pull-request
edges.summary: The CI job fetches the base ref and runs the pull-request checkpoint against it.

edges.label: run(req, state_dir)
edges.summary: `osf verify` no longer runs checks itself; it hands the request to the checkpoint runner, which is the only path to a check now.

edges.label: moon::run_holding
edges.summary: The runner takes the report lock, clears stale SARIF, then asks the adapter to run the checkpoint's tagged targets.

edges.label: one event per task
edges.summary: Every task outcome becomes a verification event, followed by one checkpoint-complete event carrying the slot table.

edges.label: clear, then read back
edges.summary: Stale SARIF is deleted before moon runs and read back after, so a failed task with no file reports unknown findings rather than zero.

edges.label: run / query tasks
edges.summary: The adapter spawns moon with the file list on stdin, and separately queries moon for the tasks tagged for a checkpoint and their slots.

edges.label: selects by tag
edges.summary: Moon reads the workspace and project files to decide which tasks a tag selects and whether they are affected.

edges.label: osf check <name>
edges.summary: Each task's command is one `osf check <name> --checkpoint <name> --sarif-out ...`, reading its file list from OSF_FILES_FROM.

edges.label: --sarif-out
edges.summary: A check writes its findings as SARIF 2.1.0 to the path the task names, creating parent folders.

edges.label: HEAD / index content
edges.summary: A check reads its content through the git plumbing: HEAD at every checkpoint but hook, the index for scan-staged.

edges.label: base, files, hashes
edges.summary: The runner resolves the base ref, the changed or staged file list, and the index and commit-range fingerprints through the git plumbing.

edges.label: append JSONL
edges.summary: Each event is serialised as one JSON line and appended to the run's buffer file.

edges.label: runReport.json, logs, lock
edges.summary: Moon writes its run report and per-task logs here; the runner's lock file lives beside them.

flows.title: A pre-push checkpoint run
flows.summary: What happens between `git push` and the exit code: the hook calls verify, verify resolves the pushed-to ref and the changed files, moon runs the tagged tasks, and each task's SARIF is read back into the journal.

messages.label: resolve base: pushed-to ref, else upstream, else empty tree
messages.note: A first push with no remote ref falls back to the empty tree, so every file and commit it sends is checked rather than nothing.

request.shape: repository-relative paths, one per line on stdin

messages.label: osf check scan --checkpoint pre-push
messages.note: One invocation per tagged task; the file list reaches the check through OSF_FILES_FROM, since moon cannot forward it.

response.shape: { runs: [{ results: [{ ruleId, level, message, suppressions? }] }] }

messages.label: exit 0 / 1 / 2
messages.note: 0 ran clean or nothing to check, 1 at least one task failed, 2 could not run.

views.title: Checkpoint architecture
views.summary: How a checkpoint reaches a check now: entry points call `osf verify`, which delegates to the checkpoint runner, which drives moon and reads the results back.

views.title: moon adapter internals
views.summary: The adapter's own pieces: version gate, report lock, stdin file list, run-report parsing, and the task query that supplies slots.

children.title: osf check content sources
children.summary: Which content a check reads, per checkpoint: disk at hook, git HEAD elsewhere, the index for scan-staged.
